# Legacy parity oracles

These three archived Dash modules are parsed as source by exporter regression tests. They are never imported or served as an application. Keeping the original callback calculations provides an independent parity reference without Dash/Plotly/Gunicorn runtime dependencies. The complete runnable legacy application is preserved on `archive/pre-modern-dashboard` at `c056c8be7e3479a6c247db8303e9c066df3b0018`.
